description: Six rounds of the [[72,12,6]] bivariate bicycle code as a Z memory, read out in the program; every ion reset; then six rounds as an X memory, read out by the grader (144 ions: 72 data, 72 ancillas, reset and reused every round). The circuit is Bravyi et al.'s depth-8 schedule (arXiv:2308.07915; circuit distance 6). Goal 3 fixes this code and compares architectures by the time per round and the logical error rate per round (a round fails when either memory does) under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
